id: E4 - held-out validation of frozen MINT (R1, dense counterfactual) on block H
written: 2026-10-23, after the spoof_blind development run on block T and before any block-H byte is downloaded
frozen_code_note: All code that produces the E4 numbers is at this commit: src/mint (R1, v0, pipeline, compose, effects, rays, ground, attacks incl. attacks/blind.py), runners/e0_stream.py, e0_analyze.py, e4_stream.py, e4_analyze.py. sha256 of the key files below. Nothing in them changes after this file is committed; if something must change, E4 stops and is reported.
user_decisions: D-50 (cost reported as measured overhead vs n, no D-17 pass/fail; post hoc), D-51 (frozen method), D-52 (block H held-out, nothing fitted), recorded as proposed entries in commit 160166e before any E4 code ran

method_frozen.name: MINT-v0 with rule R1 (D-40, D-51)
method_frozen.rule: src/mint/reliability/r1.py assess() with v0.Params() (n_min = 3, variant 'std'); Wilson 95% resolvability margins; KNOWN unit gates iff >= 1 effect gates and no effect is resolvably useful; UNKNOWN (any effect box with < 3 receiver rays) and the receiver's own box = keep
method_frozen.counterfactual: dense: one decode per excluded-sender subset (e0_stream.decode_all; equals pipeline.mint_frame cf_mode='sequential')
method_frozen.output: finalize(compose(cands, gating_choice)) (D-39); no extra decode with n = 2
method_frozen.trigger_T005: cost variant only (D-51): pipeline.mint_frame cf_mode='trigger', trigger_f = 0.05; timed, never used for any accuracy number

data.agents: each block-H scenario has 2 CAV folders in the archive (central-directory metadata, read before this file): block H has n <= 2 only. Overhead vs n is therefore measured at n = 2 (and n = 1 if a frame has the second CAV out of range); there is no block-H measurement for n >= 3, and the E3 n = 3..5 projections are not repeated.
data.source: OPV2V validate archive only (e0_stream.VAL_URL); members under validate/<allowlisted scenario>/ only; the test archive is never contacted
data.seen_before: only archive metadata (names, member sizes) of these 4 scenarios; no point cloud, label or detector output

safeguards.budget_check: before the first byte: already-downloaded + 1.01 x sum of the member sizes of all scenarios still to fetch must be <= 3.2e9, else refuse (0 bytes); re-checked per scenario and after each download
safeguards.disk: one scenario on disk at a time (stream dir emptied before each download; content checked to be exactly that scenario); raw <= 3e9 bytes
safeguards.deletion: raw deleted after the scenario cache is written and re-read
safeguards.stop: stop if the budget would be exceeded, any non-allowlisted scenario or any test scenario would be touched, or a compose check fails

attacks.seeds: frame randomness np.random.seed(stage1_reproduce.frame_seed(scen, i, 0)); attack rng = e0_stream.rng_for(family, scen, frame, 0) per family (independent streams); same keys for every scenario

families.spoof_blind: src/mint/attacks/blind.py attack_spoof_blind (evaluation only, frozen after the block-T development run): spoof_feat with the destination restricted to free patches where the source GT box translated by the patch shift has < 3 receiver rays (SUP + TRAV, rays.classify_points on the receiver's scan) and is not the receiver's own box; up to 300 random destination draws; not applied if none found. The attacker is assumed to know the receiver's visibility (worst case). Expected R1 recovery ~ 0; it measures the known bypass.

attacks.population: as E0-E3: every frame of the 4 scenarios under clean + 5 families; a family on a frame where the attack was not applied, or a frame with n = 1, is evaluated as clean

primary_metrics.metric: absolute AP@0.7 change delta_c = AP@0.7(R1) - AP@0.7(undefended) for each of clean, spoof_feat, remove_feat, shift_feat, spoof_pts, spoof_blind; OpenCOOD AP (global_sort_detections = False, IoU 0.7), frames pooled in (scenario, frame) order
primary_metrics.ci: paired bootstrap 95% percentile CI, 2000 resamples, seed 0: (A, used for the criteria) contiguous blocks of 10 frames within each scenario, resampled within scenario (stratified); (B, reported, coarse) whole-scenario blocks (4 blocks). Resampled frames keep their original order (as E2). Implementation: runners/e4_analyze.py bootstrap()
primary_metrics.secondary: recovery = delta_f / (AP_clean_undef - AP_f_undef) (None if the attack loss < 0.005) per family and its mean over the 4 original families; AP@0.5 and its changes; clean relative loss; gated-unit precision and false rejections of USEFUL units by effect type; KNOWN/UNKNOWN/self fractions of units; attack realization; oracle and visibility-limited oracle bounds (e0_analyze.frame_policies: oracle_attacker, vis_oracle_attacker, oracle_all, vis_oracle_all) for context; overhead

success_criteria.i: mean over the 4 original families (spoof_feat, remove_feat, shift_feat, spoof_pts) of delta_f: lower bound of the 10-frame-block CI > 0
success_criteria.ii: clean relative loss 1 - AP@0.7_clean(R1) / AP@0.7_clean(undefended): upper bound of the 10-frame-block CI <= 0.01
success_criteria.iii: no original family with point delta_f < -0.002
success_criteria.success: (i) and (ii) and (iii); spoof_blind is reported but is not part of any criterion

outcome.success: recommend the frozen method for the one-time final test (a separate decision, not part of E4)
outcome.failure: recommend re-scoping to the observability study
outcome.no_rule_changes: no change to R1, the attacks, the metrics or these criteria in either case

cost_D50.protocol: E3 step-4 / D-42 protocol on every block-H frame (clean, real n), after the data pass of the scenario while its raw data is on disk: isolated receiver encode (5 reps, per-frame median); then 3 interleaved repetitions of baseline-only (receiver encode + plain fusion/decode/post-process) and, for dense and T(0.05) each, receiver encode + MINT; MINT extra = counterfactual + evidence + compose; overhead = extra / baseline-only of the same repetition; isolated-encode overhead = extra / (isolated encode p50 over all block-H frames + plain of the same repetition); per-frame median over repetitions, then p50/p95 over frames, per n. Untimed warm-up on frame 0 of each scenario. Apple M1 CPU, torch 8 intra-op / 1 inter-op threads
cost_D50.claim: reported as measured overhead vs n only; no pass/fail budget claim (D-50)

spoof_blind_development.label: DEVELOPMENT, block T dev slice (24 frames x 4 seeds = 96 attacked evaluations, n = 2); smoke test, seeds repeat frames; not an estimate
spoof_blind_development.frozen: spoof_blind is frozen at the frozen_code_commit; no change after this file is committed

deviation_from_request.what: spoof_blind was developed and smoke-tested on the 24-frame block-T dev slice (data/opv2v/devslice, raw data already on disk, n = 2) with 4 attack seeds per frame, not on the block-T caches
deviation_from_request.why: the E0/E3 block-T caches store decoded candidates, effects and receiver points but no agent features, so a new feature-level attack cannot be replayed from them; the dev slice is the only block-T raw data on disk. 0 bytes downloaded. 4 seeds per frame were needed to reach >= 50 realized attacks on 24 frames; the seeds repeat frames, so the development numbers are a smoke test, not an estimate

labelling: Block-H numbers are held-out. spoof_blind development numbers (block T, dev slice) and all E0-E3 numbers are development / in-sample and are reported separately.
no_changes: decision_log.md is not edited; proposals go to the appendix of planning/e4_report.md and planning/decision_log_proposed_appendix.md only
